props.description: The doorway back to the chapel, standing open.
An open doorway north into colder stone. Nothing bars it.
A bookcase pulled a little from the west wall, its shelves empty except for rot.

props.revealHint: The bookcase has been pulled a finger's width from the wall; the dust behind it is broken. Searching the bookcase would find it.
props.description: A niche behind the bookcase, packed with grave-lists gone to pulp.
A plain coffin on the east side, the lid still nailed.
A warped barrel, its hoops rusted shut.
A yellowed bone on the flags, too long for a dog.
A spill of fallen masonry near the south wall.
A thick cobweb in the west corner.

dmNotes.overview: A low undercroft, cracked flags and a bookcase that does not belong. An open door south to the chapel, an open door north toward something colder.
dmNotes.sensory: Colder than the chapel. The smell is wet paper and old wood. Footsteps sound closer than they are.
dmNotes.theDoor: Both doors stand open. A fight is the only thing that would stop them walking through.
